parlays.name: The daily 6
parlays.why: Six legs balancing the chance of all landing together with measured value against the market: at most two per game, every priced leg worth taking on its own, none with a psychological spot against it.

parlays.name: Core 3
parlays.why: The three strongest legs of the daily 6. Fewer legs, much less bookmaker margin: the mathematically sounder ticket.

parlays.name: Same-game 3
parlays.why: Three legs from one game that tend to land together (positive correlation). Bookmakers reprice same-game combos, so compare their price with the minimum odds.
